messages:
anya: FYI ran a focused onboarding smoke for comet-v2 (quant=q5k) & hit mirrored punctuation in several RTL and CJK locales. posting the minimal repros.

raphael: can you paste the exact eval command and one failing sample?

anya: eval: `./bin/onboard_eval --model comet-v2 --quant q5k --suite multilang:translate_smoke --locales he,ar,zh-HK --out /tmp/comet_q5k_smoke.jsonl`

anya: sample he:
- src: "(\u05d0\u05d9\u05e8) 08/31"
- ref: "(City) 08/31"
- comet-q5k: "(\u05d0\u05d9\u05e8] 08/31"  <-- ')' -> ']'

sam: interesting. show tokenizer token dump pre-detok and detok output.

anya: tokens pre-detok: `["(","\u05d0\u05d9\u05e8",")"," ","08","/","31"]`
comet-q5k detok stream: `["(","\u05d0\u05d9\u05e8","]"," ","08","/","31"]`

raphael: pre-detok identical to baseline q8?

anya: yes. q8 detok yields correct ")". So likely detok normalization path differs in q5k packs.

L10n-bot: /report locale_issue model=comet-v2 quant=q5k suite=multilang:translate_smoke delta_bleu_he=-0.61 delta_bleu_zhHK=-0.19 samples=420

sam: quick grep: recent change added ICU-based bidi/normalize fallback in runtime/detok.c (commit e2b1f). Could be ICU mirroring + our mirror table double-applying.

raphael: if ICU was linked into the detok binary for q5k builds it could flip mirror pairs at glyph level. Any build metadata?

Build-bot: /build meta model=comet-v2 variant=q5k kernel=kernel_pack_2026-04-08-abc123 ICU_DETOK=true

anya: confirmed ICU_DETOK=true for q5k; baseline q8 had ICU_DETOK=false.

sam: hypothesis: detok runs mirror-table substitution then ICU bidi mirroring, resulting in swapped/incorrect closing symbols for mixed-script tokens. That would explain bracket -> bracket-switch.

raphael: can you reproduce detok output by invoking detok binary directly with both configs? e.g., `./bin/detok --config noicu` vs `--config icu` on the same token stream.

anya: did that locally: `./bin/detok --config icu "(\u05d0\u05d9\u05e8) 08/31"` -> `(\u05d0\u05d9\u05e8] 08/31` ; `--config noicu` -> `(\u05d0\u05d9\u05e8) 08/31`. So ICU path is the culprit.

sam: mitigation: route affected locales (he, ar, zh-HK) to q8 until we ship a hotfix. Also add unit test for mixed-script punctuation adjacency.

raphael: quick temporary routing snippet applied in console:
```json
{"routing":{"locale_overrides":{"he":"comet-v2-q8","ar":"comet-v2-q8","zh-HK":"comet-v2-q8"}}}
```

L10n-bot: incident logged INC-2026-511 comet-detok-icu-mirror (priority=P2)

anya: plan: either disable ICU_DETOK for detok pipeline in q5k packs or harmonize by removing mirror-table substitution when ICU is enabled. Which is lower risk?

sam: disabling ICU_DETOK in the detok build is lower risk and quick. We'll prepare a hotfix build with ICU_DETOK=false and run the smoke harness. If that passes, roll out new packs.

raphael: I'll open PR to enforce ICU_DETOK=false for quant pack builds until we have canonicalized normalization. tagging runtime and build infra.

anya: created ticket ML-ONBOARD-712 with artifacts, detok diffs, and hotfix plan. attaching sample set used for smoke.

sam: also add an eval threshold alert so any future quant pack that toggles ICU_DETOK triggers a regression check on multilingual detok samples.

raphael: noted. thanks all — will update when hotfix build is green.

anya: thanks! keeping this thread as the canonical log for the incident. :white_check_mark:
